title: 🎉 musicOS v2.0.6 Update is Out!
message:
Hey everyone!

musicOS Version 2.0.6 is officially out now with exciting new features and critical fixes!

✨ What's New & Fixed in v2.0.6:
• 🎨 Custom Playlist Covers: Now upload custom photos directly from your device storage for your playlists (permanent across reinstalls & re-logins)!
• 📻 Dedicated MusicOS Logo: Sleek 3-waves MusicOS emblem on the Radio navigation tab and station cards.
• ⚡ 400 Bad Request Fixes: Resolved all 400 errors when opening Songs, Albums, Artists, and Library shelves.
• 🔔 Background Update Alerts: Receive high-priority notifications when updates drop even if the app is closed.
• 💎 Liquid Glass & Performance: Ultra-smooth 60/120fps scrolling and refined UI rendering.

⚠️ Reminder: Jis jis ne abhi tak update nahi kiya hai, please update check karein aur latest version v2.0.6 par update karein!

Thank you for your continuous love and support.
— Developer of musicOS
